mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_template_file (owner_user_id, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, content, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, content, created_at, deleted_at FROM marketing_template_file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
